stories.title: Face à la hausse des cas de Covid-19 en France, faut-il avancer la campagne de vaccination, prévue pour commencer le 13 octobre ?

en.title: With rising Covid-19 cases in France, should the vaccination campaign scheduled to start on October 13 be moved up?
en.summary: Some healthcare workers are calling for an immediate Covid-19 vaccination campaign, but the Health Ministry states current indicators do not justify accelerating the campaign planned for October 13.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : 984 personnes interpellées ce lundi, 715 blessés côté forces de l’ordre depuis le début de la mobilisation

en.title: High school blockades: 984 people arrested on Monday, 715 law enforcement officers injured since the beginning of the student movement
en.summary: Since mid-September protests began, over 5,000 people including 87% minors have been held in custody, with 14 detention orders issued. Monday saw 984 arrests and 715 police injuries during high school blockade actions.

stories.title: Canada : les indépendantistes remportent les élections provinciales au Québec

en.title: Canada: Separatists win provincial elections in Quebec
en.summary: The Parti Québécois won Quebec's provincial elections and pledged to organize a new referendum on independence.

stories.title: Canada : les indépendantistes remportent les élections au Québec et promettent un référendum

en.title: Canada: Separatists win elections in Quebec and promise a referendum
en.summary: The Parti Québécois, led by Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, won Quebec elections with approximately 28% of votes but without an absolute majority. The new premier stated he would wait for the end of Donald Trump's term before organizing an independence referendum.

stories.title: Au Québec, les indépendantistes remportent les élections et promettent un nouveau référendum sur la sortie du Canada

en.title: In Quebec, separatists win elections and promise new referendum on leaving Canada
en.summary: The Parti Québécois won the Quebec election and pledged to hold a referendum on the province's separation from Canada, though the party indicated such a vote would not occur before the end of Donald Trump's presidency.

stories.title: L’armée américaine va mettre à mort par peloton d’exécution un condamné à la peine capitale

en.title: US military to execute death row inmate by firing squad
en.summary: President Donald Trump approved the military execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people in a 2009 shooting at a Texas military base.

stories.title: Fusillade de Fort Hood : Donald Trump approuve la mise à mort du tireur par peloton d'exécution

en.title: Fort Hood shooting: Donald Trump approves execution by firing squad of shooter
en.summary: Donald Trump approved the execution by firing squad of Nidal Malik Hasan, a former military psychiatrist who killed 13 people at Fort Hood military base in Texas in 2009 in protest against wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.

stories.title: Trump approuve la mise à mort par peloton d’exécution de l’auteur de la tuerie de Fort Hood

en.title: Trump approves execution by firing squad of Fort Hood shooting perpetrator
en.summary: President Trump authorized the execution by firing squad of Nidal Hasan, who opened fire at a medical facility on Fort Hood base in November 2009, killing soldiers to protest what he deemed illegal wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.

stories.title: Transfigurée par ses remplaçants, l'équipe de France renverse la Belgique en Ligue des nations

en.title: Transformed by its substitutes, the French team defeats Belgium in the Nations League
en.summary: France beat Belgium 4-1 in a Nations League match, with substitute appearances by Désiré Doué, Michael Olise and Rayan Cherki delivering a decisive impact and marking Zinédine Zidane's first victory on home soil.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : les accusations de violences policières se multiplient à la veille d’une importante journée de mobilisation

en.title: High school blockades: accusations of police violence multiply on the eve of major mobilization day
en.summary: Protest movements over high school blockades resumed Monday with accusations of police violence mounting as a major demonstration is planned for Tuesday. The government has proposed five initiatives to address the movement while denying excessive use of force.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : un lycéen gravement blessé à la veille d'un "acte III" mardi

en.title: High school blockades: a student gravely injured on the eve of a third act Tuesday
en.summary: A 15-year-old student lost a hand during incidents Monday as high school blockades continue with union support planned for Tuesday's escalated protest. Several establishments remained closed with multiple violent incidents reported.

stories.title: Loïk le Priol, condamné à vingt-six ans de prison pour le meurtre de Federico Martin Aramburu à Paris, fait appel

en.title: Loïk le Priol, sentenced to twenty-six years in prison for the murder of Federico Martin Aramburu in Paris, appeals
en.summary: Loïk le Priol has appealed his twenty-six-year prison sentence for Federico Martin Aramburu's murder in Paris. Co-defendant Romain Bouvier, sentenced to nineteen years, also filed an appeal.

stories.title: Pourquoi Pasqal a été contraint d'abandonner le programme de défense Proqcima

en.title: Why Pasqal was forced to abandon the Proqcima defense program
en.summary: France's Defence Ministry excluded quantum startup Pasqal from the Proqcima defense program due to concerns that its New York stock exchange listing posed risks to sovereign technology protection.

stories.title: Soutien : le salon AD2S porté par le contexte international

en.title: Support: the AD2S trade show buoyed by international context
en.summary: The Aerospace & Defence Support and Services trade show took place in late September at Bordeaux Mérignac air base, with military and industrial participants focused on combat maintenance concepts.

stories.title: Tribune. Financement des litiges par des tiers : solution stratégique pour l'aéronautique et la défense

en.title: Commentary: Third-party litigation financing as strategic solution for aerospace and defense
en.summary: An opinion piece discusses third-party litigation financing as a strategic approach for companies in the aerospace and defense sectors.

stories.title: Vendre les actifs non stratégiques de la Caisse des dépôts : la Cour des comptes cible un portefeuille de 31,6 milliards

en.title: Court of Auditors targets Caisse des dépôts non-strategic assets worth 31.6 billion euros for sale
en.summary: France's Court of Auditors is urging the Caisse des dépôts to divest non-strategic holdings valued at 31.6 billion euros in 2026 and return proceeds to the state while preserving group revenues.

stories.title: Portrait : générale de brigade Solène Le Floch, commandante de la Brigade aérienne d'assaut projection

en.title: Profile: Brigadier General Solène Le Floch, Commander of the Airborne Assault Projection Brigade
en.summary: Brigadier General Solène Le Floch commands the Airborne Assault Projection Brigade and specializes in operations on unprepared terrain.
